name: 通勤手当 (commuting allowance)
authority: 所得税法 §9(1)(v); 所得税法施行令 §20の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm; https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm): a 通勤手当 is untaxed up to the monthly limit INCOME_TAX computes from the terms facts commute_transit_fare, commute_vehicle_km and commute_parking_fee; the excess is taxable pay of the month paid. 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §2(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): a 通勤手当 is 賃金, so it bears 雇用保険 and 労災保険 in full. The monthly limit assumes a monthly allowance; a multi-month 定期 payment is not configured.
